title: Section registry
description: The ordered list of sections the site renders. Read by Hugo (hugo.Data.sections) and by the LaTeX CV, so the website and the PDF cannot drift apart.

id.description: Anchor id on the homepage, and the default for data, style and the i18n label key.

data.description: Data file behind the section, without the .json suffix. Defaults to id.

style.description: Renderer to use: partials/sections/<style>.html, falling back to the generic renderer. Defaults to id.

label.description: Heading text. Overrides the i18n lookup, so a new section needs no translation entry.

cvLabel.description: Heading used in the generated CV, where the wording is often longer than on the site ("Conference and seminar presentations" against "Conferences"). Defaults to label.

featuredOnly.description: Show only records with featured: true on the homepage.

homepageLimit.description: Cap the homepage records. 0 means no cap.

weight.description: Ordering in the nav and on the homepage. Defaults to declaration order.

inCV.description: Include this section in the generated CV.

groupField.description: Field to group records by, rendering a subheading per distinct value.
